name: hk-restricted-services
description: Selective routing for services unavailable or region-sensitive from Hong Kong egress

services.name: OpenAI / ChatGPT / API
services.reason: OpenAI's official ChatGPT and API support lists do not include Hong Kong.

sources.title: OpenAI API - Supported Countries and Territories

services.name: Anthropic / Claude / Claude API
services.reason: Anthropic's official Claude availability list does not include Hong Kong.

services.name: Google AI Studio / Gemini API
services.reason: Google's official available-regions list for AI Studio and Gemini API does not include Hong Kong; the Gemini web app has a separate country list.

sources.title: Available regions for Google AI Studio and Gemini API

services.name: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code endpoints
services.reason: Added from the supplied developer endpoint list. Google documents Antigravity and Cloud Code, but I did not find an official Hong Kong country-availability statement for these endpoints.

sources.title: Google Antigravity download and product site

services.name: TikTok / ByteDance delivery services
services.reason: TikTok announced a Hong Kong app withdrawal in 2020, while current app-store and business-service evidence is mixed. It is included as a region-sensitive candidate for Hong Kong egress rather than a uniformly confirmed block.

sources.title: TikTok statement on leaving Hong Kong
